html:
What is Python and what are its main features?

Supplied answer
Python is a high-level, interpreted, general-purpose programming language created by Guido van
Rossum. Main features: simple English-like syntax, dynamically typed (no need to declare types),
interpreted (runs line by line), platform independent, object oriented, free and open source, and it has a
very large standard library plus packages like NumPy, Pandas and Django.

Preserved as supplied; not independently validated or executed
